title: Thousands of “ghost students” use AI to steal millions in student loans, DOJ says
gist: The DOJ charged five people and seized over $750,000 in crypto from a Kenya-linked network in the first broad federal crackdown on "ghost students" who use stolen identities and AI to enroll in classes and siphon federal student aid. The Department of Education has flagged over 830,000 potentially fraudulent aid accounts (losses near $130 million if all are fake), while advocates warn new automated identity verification may wrongly block low-income real students.
